result.instructions: Tools for CloudTalk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which calls were missed yesterday, and who called back?"; "Show the contact Jane Doe and her open tags."; "Which agents are on a call right now, and which groups are waiting?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CloudTalk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cloudtalk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cloudtalk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cloudtalk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cloudtalk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List call history, newest first, with filters by date range, agent extension, contact, call type or status. Classic API: GET /calls/index.json.

date_from.description: Calls that started at or after this time, for example 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

date_to.description: Calls that started at or before this time, for example 2026-11-30 23:59:59.

public_external.description: Number of the caller or callee.

contact_id.description: Only calls assigned to this contact id.

user_id.description: Only calls assigned to this agent id.

agent_extension.description: Only calls of this agent extension.

tag_id.description: Only calls with this call tag id.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_call
tools.title: Get call details
tools.description: Get the details of one call: parties, times, duration, agent and outcome. Analytics API: GET /calls/{callId}.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_call_tags
tools.title: List call tags
tools.description: List the call tags an agent can add to calls, optionally for one direction or one user or group. GET /call-tags.

callType.description: Only tags for this direction, plus tags for both.

userId.description: Only tags visible to this user's groups. Cannot combine with groupId.

groupId.description: Only tags visible to this group. Cannot combine with userId.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous answer's pagination.next. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_call_tags_for_call
tools.title: List a call's tags
tools.description: List the call tags assigned to one call. GET /calls/{callId}/tags.

call_id.description: The numeric call id or the call uuid.

tools.name: cloudtalk_add_call_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a call
tools.description: Add call tags to one call. Tags already on the call are ignored, so a repeat call changes nothing. POST /calls/{callId}/tags.

call_id.description: The numeric call id or the call uuid.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_group_statistics
tools.title: Get real-time group statistics
tools.description: Read live call statistics per agent group right now (waiting, answered, missed, agents online). Classic API: GET /statistics/realtime/groups.json.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_contacts
tools.title: List and search contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts and leads, with their numbers, emails, tags and custom fields. Use customField and customFieldValue for an exact match on your own key. GET /contacts.

search.description: Word-prefix search on names and company; phone digits; emails by substring.

updatedSince.description: Only contacts changed through the API or the dashboard at or after this time.

customField.description: Name of a custom field to match exactly. Needs customFieldValue.

customFieldValue.description: Value the custom field must hold, 1 to 255 characters. Needs customField.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous answer's pagination.next. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: cloudtalk_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact or lead by id, with every number, email, tag and custom field. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: cloudtalk_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact or lead. Invalid phones or emails are rejected, not dropped. matchBy phone/email/emailOrPhone updates an existing match instead of creating a duplicate. POST /contacts.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example CZ.

customFields.description: Custom field values, keyed by the field name from cloudtalk_list_contact_fields.

favoriteUserId.description: The user id who owns the contact.

matchBy.description: Duplicate check. Default none: always create.

idempotency_key.description: Retry-safe key. The same key and body return the same contact.

tools.name: cloudtalk_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change fields of one contact. phones and emails replace the whole list. customFields merge by key; a key set to null is removed. PATCH /contacts/{contactId}.

type.description: contact turns a lead into a contact. A contact cannot become a lead.

state.description: State or region. null clears it.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Cannot be null.

customFields.description: Custom fields to set. A null value removes that field.

favoriteUserId.description: Owner user id. null clears the owner.

tools.name: cloudtalk_add_contact_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a contact
tools.description: Add existing contact tags to one contact. Tags already on the contact are kept. POST /contacts/{contactId}/tags.

tagIds.description: Tag ids from the matching list tool.

tools.name: cloudtalk_list_contact_tags
tools.title: List contact tags
tools.description: List the contact tags in the account, optionally filtered by name. GET /contact-tags.

search.description: Tags whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
